newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Inmates on hunger strike at Venezuelan jail.
newsitem.headline: Inmates on hunger strike at Venezuelan jail.

text.p: All 1,800 inmates of a crowded Venezuelan jail have gone on hunger strike to demand justice after a fire apparently started by guards killed 25 prisoners last week, prison officials said on Thursday.
The inmates at La Planta jail in southwest Caracas began the fast Wednesday afternoon.
The protest was peaceful, one official told Reuters by telephone, but he said the prisoners "want those responsible for the fire brought to justice and punished."
Justice Ministry officials have said three national guardsmen started the fire on October 22. They said the three men lobbed tear gas canisters into a small cell with about 40 inmates locked inside.
Converted from an army barracks more than 30 years ago, La Planta jail is supposed to hold 300 prisoners.
